structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Persons to whom nonrestricted permit is granted
law.text: No person shall be granted a nonrestricted permit as a manufacturer unless he is of good moral character and properly equipped as to land, buildings, equipment and safeguards against diversion to carry out the functions of a manufacturer with due regard to the protection of the public safety.
